summary.text: Todd Podgorski is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the seat has no incumbent, and Paul Cumings (D) is also running.
A law enforcement officer, he described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a peace officer and South St. Paul city council member.

paragraphs.text: Todd Podgorski graduated from Woodbury High School, earned an associate degree from Inver Hills Community College in 1994, and received a bachelor's degree from Winona State University in 1996.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a husband and father, that his wife is an elementary teacher, and that his son is a peace officer who serves in the Minnesota National Guard.
Podgorski said in the survey that he is endorsed by both the Republican Party and the Minnesota Forward Independence Party.

He listed protecting tax dollars from fraud, waste and abuse through more audits of departments that distribute state grants, affordable single-family housing, and public safety among his campaign messages.
He also said he supports constitutional amendments for term limits, age limits and ending Citizens United.
